1.title: Jurors return in Lindsay Clancy trial after judge asks them to break deadlock
1.summary: They resumed efforts on Wednesday to reach a verdict in the case of a mother charged with murder over her children's deaths.

2.title: Trump’s Speed on the White House Ballroom Threatens to Outpace the Courts
2.summary: In his breakneck construction of a grand ballroom and in many other initiatives, critics say, the president has tried to outrun judicial review.

3.title: Tiger Woods gets five-year driving ban after reckless driving plea
3.summary: The golfer will accept a five-year driving ban and $1,000 fine as part of a plea agreement.

4.title: U.S. and Iran Survey the Damage After a Night of Intense Strikes
4.summary: The American military said its barrage was retaliation against recent attacks on U.S. forces and marine traffic. Iranian officials said a wedding was hit and civilians killed.

5.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
5.summary: Russia is accused of growing increasingly reckless after Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.

6.title: The ‘Miracle House’ That Survived Nepal’s Floods
6.summary: People are coming to take photos of the green-painted house, which kept the Pyakurel family safe as the area all around them was destroyed by rampaging floodwaters.
